title: Everyday Phrases — Taking the Subway
title_quote: Is this the way to the subway?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚇 實用坐地鐵必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Taking the Subway
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用坐地鐵情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從進站看地圖買票充值過閘機、月台等車方向上車搶座扶杆、車廂報站換乘問路廣播，到出站找出口失物招領末班車與月票，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Taking the Subway phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), following the whole subway journey: reading the map and buying or topping up a ticket at the gate, waiting on the platform, boarding, finding a seat and holding the pole, hearing announcements, transfers and onboard broadcasts, then exits, lost and found, the last train and the monthly pass. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the way to the subway?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪs ðɪs ðə weɪ tə ðə ˈsʌbweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I use this machine?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a single ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，在上面這裡拍一下卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put the money?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can top it up here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen froze on one page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the man at the booth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ticket did not come out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 服務人員需要一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a ticket, there it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a paper ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I go after this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I open the gate?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It opened, look at the map.
dialogue.zh: 門開了，我們來看大地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get downtown from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ˈdaʊntɑn frəm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我從這裡怎麼去市中心？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the airport use that green line?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði ˈɛrˌpɔrt juz ðæt ɡrin laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far east does it go?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do trains run late at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a round trip ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a day pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is a good deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, yours is one level down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is my first subway ride.
dialogue.zh: 我這還是頭一次搭地鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not worry, it is easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need it to exit later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的卡已經拿在手上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this platform for our train?
dialogue.zh: 這個月台是我們要搭的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，往北的車都在這裡停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this one the red line?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read it at the front.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We made it on, so good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not lean on the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go to the car in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, may I sit here?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這個位子我可以坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，這個位子空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I put my bag here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so glad to sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An old man is getting on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I offer him my seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家不是看書就是在打瞌睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to talk loud?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡大聲說話可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not run for the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us find the yellow line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we get off at Central Square?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi ɡɛt ɑf æt ˈsɛntrəl skwɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是在中央廣場站下的車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till the next one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find our line on the wall map.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd aʊər laɪn ɑn ðə wɔl mæp./
dialogue.zh: 在牆上的地圖找到我們的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that where we change now?
dialogue.zh: 我們就在這一站換車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一班車正從旁邊開過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you speak English?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你會說英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stay on this train?
dialogue.zh: 我能繼續留在這班車上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line do I take then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I know my stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the lights show each stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stop is dot number five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I press a stop button?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is our stop on screen?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One rider pressed a yellow button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看到無人認領的包包就通報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is this last ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay again to change?
dialogue.zh: 換乘還要再付一次錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we on the right train?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long to the next stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we going the right way?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel lost in big stations.
dialogue.zh: 在大站裡我常覺得會迷路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line four is the yellow line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你今天一整天都在指點我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you should rest a bit.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你確實該休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是每站停的慢車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有沒有跳站直達的快車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會有一班快車在我們之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three stops left on our route.
dialogue.zh: 我們的路線上還剩三站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rider beside us got off.
dialogue.zh: 坐在我們旁邊的乘客下車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can sit in those seats.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以坐那兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it was on my head.
dialogue.zh: 不是，它剛剛還在我頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us ask the station staff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the exit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bus home leaves from exit one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊər bʌs hoʊm livz frʌm ˈɛɡzɪt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 回家的公車從一號出口發車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ramp is good for bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the map again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask a worker at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It worked on the second try.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you know the map now.
dialogue.zh: 真好，你已經會看地圖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這條街和地圖畫得一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us ask the lost and found.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs æsk ðə lɔst ænd faʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 我們去失物招領處問問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It must be on the train.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們保管乘客遺落的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a rider handed it in.
dialogue.zh: 說不定有乘客撿了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 工作人員找到我的帽子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, our bus is leaving.
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我們的公車要開走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the last one is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it too late to catch it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt tu leɪt tə kætʃ ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這是今晚最後一班公車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just in time, look at that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 車門在我們身後關上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there many people on board?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a monthly pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you ride a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are here, this is our stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr hɪr, ðɪs ɪz aʊər stɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us step off the bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The street is calm and quiet.
dialogue.zh: 外面的街上安靜又平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I will get the pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us ride again next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am ready for my bed.
